title: Gun model info (glTF root node extras.info)
description: Metres. The glTF frame (x = right, y = up, z = -forward) with the origin at the gun's own origin (the point the recipe builds around: roughly the back of the receiver on the bore line). Every anchor in `info` is written [forward, up, right] = [-z, y, x]; a node's transform is in the same frame, so a part is built "in place" and its node origin is only its pivot. Generated from js/glb.ts INFO_FIELDS: do not edit (npm run check:models -- --write).

sy.description: Height of the line of sight above the origin, metres up: where the sight picture sits.

fSight.description: Forward position of the front sight (or the sight's front), metres: with sy and relief it places the aiming eye.

relief.description: Eye relief, metres: how far behind the sight the eye sits when aiming.

muzzles.description: Where the bullet leaves, one [forward, up, right] metres entry per barrel (usually one; an over/under has two, a barrel block more): never assume [0] is the only one. The flash, tracers and shot start here. A part may provide them (GUN_MODEL_CONTRACT.anchors).

grip.description: Where the firing hand's palm sits on the grip, [forward, up, right] metres.

support.description: Where the support hand takes the gun (handguard, foregrip, magazine), [forward, up, right] metres.

anim.description: Animated parts: key (a PARTS value) -> the NAME of its `part_<key>` node. Rebuilt into live node references at load.

oneOf.description: Where the magazine seats: [forward, up] metres of its top/centre in the well. Present exactly when the model has a part_mag.

magAt.description: Where the magazine seats: [forward, up] metres of its top/centre in the well. Present exactly when the model has a part_mag.

f.description: Forward position of the handle, metres.

y.description: Height of the handle above the origin, metres.

x.description: Sideways position, metres, right positive (a left-hand handle is negative).

travel.description: How far it moves back when worked, metres.

oneOf.description: Where the hand takes it, [forward, up, right] metres (default: its own [f, y, x]).

grab.description: Where the hand takes it, [forward, up, right] metres (default: its own [f, y, x]).

oneOf.description: True if it reciprocates with the bolt (an AK, a Thompson: it moves with every shot).

recip.description: True if it reciprocates with the bolt (an AK, a Thompson: it moves with every shot).

oneOf.description: Shape of the handle (free text, e.g. "fold", "tube", "pair", "top").

style.description: Shape of the handle (free text, e.g. "fold", "tube", "pair", "top").

oneOf.description: Size of the handle, metres (free, per style).

sz.description: Size of the handle, metres (free, per style).

oneOf.description: Length of the handle stem, metres (free, per style).

stem.description: Length of the handle stem, metres (free, per style).

oneOf.description: The cocking handle, when there is one (part_handle).

handle.description: The cocking handle, when there is one (part_handle).

oneOf.description: The ejection port, [forward, up, right] metres: where spent cases leave.

port.description: The ejection port, [forward, up, right] metres: where spent cases leave.

f.description: Forward of the case head, metres.

w.description: Width of the open top, metres.

z.description: Half the cylinder's length, metres (the face the rounds show on).

R.description: Radius of the ring of chambers, metres.

heads.description: Case heads at the open breech: [sideways, up] metres from the hinge, one per barrel.

z.description: Back/forward offset in the hinge frame, metres.

oneOf.description: True: the bore shows there when it is empty.

bore.description: True: the bore shows there when it is empty.

oneOf.description: Where a round shows in the chamber, as `side` says (a tagged union).

chamberAt.description: Where a round shows in the chamber, as `side` says (a tagged union).

at.description: [forward, up] metres of the open breech from the hinge pin.

oneOf.description: Which long handguard it carries, "irons" or "rail", or null.

long.description: Which long handguard it carries, "irons" or "rail", or null.

oneOf.description: A tipping breech (the Thor): where it sits once open.

breech.description: A tipping breech (the Thor): where it sits once open.

oneOf.description: The charging handle's grab point, [forward, up, right] metres.

ch.description: The charging handle's grab point, [forward, up, right] metres.

oneOf.description: The bolt's rear, where the hand pulls it, [forward, up, right] metres.

bolt.description: The bolt's rear, where the hand pulls it, [forward, up, right] metres.

oneOf.description: A bullpup: the forward position (metres) the eye rests at when aiming, whatever sight is on the rail.

cheek.description: A bullpup: the forward position (metres) the eye rests at when aiming, whatever sight is on the rail.

oneOf.description: A long-recoil barrel: how far it runs back each shot, metres (0 or absent: none).

recoilBarrel.description: A long-recoil barrel: how far it runs back each shot, metres (0 or absent: none).

oneOf.description: True for a handgun: the hands, the ADS and the holster use the pistol pose.

pistol.description: True for a handgun: the hands, the ADS and the holster use the pistol pose.

oneOf.description: A pistol slide's grab point, [forward, up, right] metres. Present exactly when the model has a part_slide.

slide.description: A pistol slide's grab point, [forward, up, right] metres. Present exactly when the model has a part_slide.

oneOf.description: A revolver cylinder's centre, [forward, up, right] metres.

cylAt.description: A revolver cylinder's centre, [forward, up, right] metres.

at.description: [forward, up] metres of each open breech.

oneOf.description: A break-open gun: where the open breeches are and the angle the barrels tip to.

load.description: A break-open gun: where the open breeches are and the angle the barrels tip to.

oneOf.description: Where the left hand cups the frame (a derringer), [forward, up, right] metres.

cup.description: Where the left hand cups the frame (a derringer), [forward, up, right] metres.

oneOf.description: True when the hand takes the magazine from its top instead of its base.

magTop.description: True when the hand takes the magazine from its top instead of its base.

oneOf.description: A crossbow's bolt materials as three.js Material JSON (free-form; viewmodel only).

quarrelMats.description: A crossbow's bolt materials as three.js Material JSON (free-form; viewmodel only).

oneOf.description: Mount points where a swappable part sits, `mount_<slot>` -> [forward, up, right] metres of the part's origin (e.g. mount_muzzle: where a muzzle device screws on). Normally assembled from the parts' anchors (see GUN_MODEL_CONTRACT.anchors); a whole-gun bake may list them directly.

mounts.description: Mount points where a swappable part sits, `mount_<slot>` -> [forward, up, right] metres of the part's origin (e.g. mount_muzzle: where a muzzle device screws on). Normally assembled from the parts' anchors (see GUN_MODEL_CONTRACT.anchors); a whole-gun bake may list them directly.

f.description: Forward position of the window, metres.

oneOf.description: True: a disc of diameter w.

round.description: True: a disc of diameter w.

kind.description: The reticle: dot, dotG (green dot), cdot (circle-dot) or holo (a ring).

oneOf.description: A reflex or holographic sight's window (js/viewmodel.ts): the game draws a collimated reticle behind it, masked to it. f, y: the window's centre, [forward, up] metres; w, h: its size, metres (round: a disc of diameter w); kind: the reticle drawn: dot, dotG, dotP (a small precision dot), cdot or holo.

reflex.description: A reflex or holographic sight's window (js/viewmodel.ts): the game draws a collimated reticle behind it, masked to it. f, y: the window's centre, [forward, up] metres; w, h: its size, metres (round: a disc of diameter w); kind: the reticle drawn: dot, dotG, dotP (a small precision dot), cdot or holo.

f.description: Forward position of the lens, metres.

y.description: Height of the lens centre, metres.

oneOf.description: Node name the lens hangs on.

parent.description: Node name the lens hangs on.

oneOf.description: Place in the parent, [x, y, z] metres in its own frame.

pos.description: Place in the parent, [x, y, z] metres in its own frame.

oneOf.description: A scope's ocular lens (js/viewmodel.ts): the game draws the world through the scope on a disc there (picture-in-picture) with the reticle over it. f, y: its centre, [forward, up] metres; r: its radius. parent + pos: a lens that swings on a hinge (a magnifier's): the NAME of the node it hangs on and its place in that node, [x, y, z] metres in the node's own frame.
